sources.title: Qwen 3.5 to 3.8: Alibaba Open-Weights Guide (2026)
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.7 stayed closed and is now a skipped generation. Start with our Qwen3.8-27B complete guide and the Qwen 3.8 Max guide; this pillar remains the canonical reference for the 3.5 family. Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B is still the MLX-on-Mac coding favourite; no 3.8 Coder variant has shipped.

sources.title: Serving Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B: 350+ Experiments | NOSIBLE
sources.snippet: Qwen 3.6 35B-A3B is a mixture-of-experts model with 35 billion total parameters and roughly three billion active parameters per generated token. The checkpoint's routed-expert layout and the kernel that executes it therefore affect serving cost. We screened weight packages on H200 and RTX PRO 6000 to choose branches for deeper work.
